label: PHP + MariaDB
summary: Preset: a PHP application served by Caddy and PHP-FPM, with its own MariaDB database (DATABASE_URL in the site's secrets).
guide: Your content is a git branch or an uploaded package. It is inspected, then goes live within about 2 minutes.
If a new release fails inspection or does not answer, the last good release stays live.
The web root is the docroot (default public/) inside your repo; PHP-FPM runs your code behind Caddy.
Nothing is built on the server: ship everything the app needs in the release. Include vendor/ (run composer install first).
MariaDB runs on this container on loopback. getenv() gives DB_HOST (127.0.0.1), DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD and DATABASE_URL.
Load your schema yourself: ask an administrator, or create the tables from your app on first start.
The database is dumped daily at 02:00 and the last 14 dumps are kept on the container.
Caddy does not read .htaccess. For /page to run page.php, set options.cleanUrls; to serve the repo root instead of public/, set options.docroot to ".".
Files your app writes (uploads) must go in folders listed in options.dataDirs: kept across releases and backed up. Every push replaces the release itself.
